title: Article 7 — Rights of citizenship of certain migrants to Pakistan

content.overview: Article 7 provides that a person who after 1 March 1947 migrated from the territory of India to the territory now included in Pakistan shall not be deemed to be a citizen of India under Articles 5 and 6. A proviso saves persons who returned to India under a permit for resettlement or permanent return and allows them to be treated under Article 6 registration rules.
content.glance: Migrated India→Pakistan after 1-3-1947 → not deemed citizen under Arts 5/6. Proviso: return under resettlement permit → Art 6 registration route.
content.study:
Article 7 is the counterpart to Article 6 for outward Partition migration.

Rule: A person who after 1 March 1947 migrated from India to Pakistan is not deemed a citizen of India by virtue of Articles 5 and 6.

Proviso: If such a person has returned to the territory of India under a permit for resettlement or permanent return issued by or under the authority of any law, that person is treated for the purposes of Article 6 as if the person had migrated to India after 19 July 1948 (i.e. the registration route under Article 6 applies).

Policy: prevent dual claims arising from Partition movement while allowing orderly return under official permit.

Examination: state the 1 March 1947 date; explain the non-deeming rule; explain the proviso and its link to Article 6 registration.

sections.heading: Rule and proviso
sections.body:
Main rule: migration to Pakistan after 1 March 1947 → not deemed citizen under Arts 5 and 6.
Proviso: return under resettlement/permanent-return permit → treated as Art 6 (post-19-7-1948) migrant for registration.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Article 7.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 7 provides that a person who after 1 March 1947 migrated from India to Pakistan shall not be deemed to be a citizen of India under Articles 5 and 6. The proviso saves a person who returned to India under a permit for resettlement or permanent return; such a person is treated under the Article 6 registration route as if the migration to India occurred after 19 July 1948.

examTips: Pair with Art 6; remember 1 March 1947 and the resettlement-permit proviso.
